note: 'instead of' is held as the conjunction of a coordination of 'the second box' and 'the first', though the words make it the linking word between the two.
'instead of' is written as the conjunction of a coordination of 'the other one' and 'that one', though it links the one taken to the one left.
'whichever box isn't highlighted' opens with a question word inside the clause and states which box is wanted, but it is written as an interrogative clause.
'at all' is held as dependents of 'anything', though it says how far the connection holds and cannot describe the thing.
the command 'od a quick count of the rectangles please' loses its verb, since 'od' is held as a discourse word in a fragment.
'is the diamond for a decision or for a start?' is a question, written as a declarative clause.
'or not' negates the alternative, but 'not' is held as a discourse word and no clause carries the negation.
'which symbol' is the subject of 'was', but it is written as a second complement and the clause is left without a subject.
'straight off' is held as dependents of 'plum', though it says when and cannot describe the colour.
'plum' is written as the head of the nominal 'the first three pages plum', though 'pages' is the head and 'plum' says which colour it becomes.
'the frist three pages' is split into two nominals, 'the frist' and 'three pages', which are one description of the pages given the background.
'whatever' is the subject of 'reads', but it is held as the marker of a relation and no clause has it as subject.
'and' between '1' and '3' is held as a discourse word, so the coordination of the two page numbers is lost.
'on each page' starts at the clause of 'prints', though it belongs with 'plum behind everything' before the dash.
'indigo' is held as a nominal tied to 'the copy', though it says how the copy is recoloured.
'join them' is a command, written as a declarative clause with 'Draft and Edit' as its subject.
'Sow' is a nominal held as a modifier of the clause beside 'itno', so the relation to the box it is folded into is lost.
the command 'spilt the Chop box into two steps' is written as a declarative clause.
'sand backdrop' is tied by a relation to 'the previous layout', though it describes the page being created.
